<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#401b2c">
<title>Rhyanna Mhae Caliso | HUMSS Portfolio</title>
<style>
:root{--wine:#4b2033;--wine2:#6a3048;--gold:#c99d50;--cream:#fbf7ef;--ink:#302832;--muted:#766d72;--paper:#fffdf9;--line:#eadfce}
*{box-sizing:border-box;scroll-behavior:auto}
body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(251,247,239,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.navwrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:15px 5%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.brand{font:800 14px/1.2 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--wine)}
.brand span{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;margin-top:4px}
nav{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
nav a{font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#5b5057;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:30px;transition:.25s}
nav a:hover,nav a.active{background:var(--wine);color:white}
.menu{display:none;background:var(--wine);color:white;border:0;border-radius:22px;padding:10px 14px}
section{scroll-margin-top:0}
main section{display:none}
main section.active{display:block}
main section#home.active{display:grid}
.profile-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
.profile-photo{width:94px;height:94px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #f1e6d5;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #4b20331a}
.profile-subtitle{font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:90px 5%}
.eyebrow{font:700 11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,82px);line-height:.98;color:var(--wine);margin:18px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,48px);color:var(--wine);margin:12px 0 18px}
h3{color:var(--wine);font-size:21px}
.lead{font:17px/1.8 Arial,sans-serif;color:#655b61;max-width:650px}
.hero{min-height:650px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;align-items:center;gap:45px;padding-top:75px;padding-bottom:75px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:440px;height:440px;border:1px solid #e8d9c3;border-radius:50%;right:-170px;top:80px;z-index:-1}
.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:260px;height:260px;background:#f1e6d5;border-radius:50%;right:40px;top:170px;z-index:-1}
.name-line{font:700 13px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:4px;color:var(--wine2);text-transform:uppercase}
.hero h1 em{font-weight:400;color:var(--gold)}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:28px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:30px;background:var(--wine);color:white;font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;border:1px solid var(--wine);transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:var(--wine2)}
.btn.outline{background:transparent;color:var(--wine)}
.hero-card{background:var(--paper);padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 25px 70px #4b20331a;transform:rotate(2deg);max-width:370px;margin:auto}
.hero-card img{width:100%;height:300px;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:saturate(.7)}
.card-caption{padding:18px 8px 8px;text-align:center}
.card-caption strong{display:block;color:var(--wine);font-size:20px}
.card-caption small{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold)}
.section-head{max-width:720px;margin-bottom:38px}
.about-grid,.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
.panel{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:30px;border-radius:5px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #4b20330a}
.panel p,.item p{font:14px/1.85 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.fact{padding:16px;background:#f7f0e5;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.fact b{display:block;color:var(--wine);font:700 11px Arial,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}
.fact span{font:14px Arial,sans-serif;color:#655b61}
.tinted{background:#f3ecdf}
.skills-grid,.work-grid,.project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.skill,.item{background:var(--paper);padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.skill .num{font:italic 32px Georgia;color:var(--gold)}
.skill h3{margin:12px 0 8px}
.skill p{font:13px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.tag{display:inline-block;margin:6px 5px 0 0;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:#f4ead9;color:var(--wine);font:10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.5px}
.work-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.item{padding:28px}
.item .type{font:700 10px Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase}
.item h3{margin:12px 0}
.quote{background:var(--wine);color:#fff;padding:48px;border-radius:5px;position:relative}
.quote p{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);line-height:1.5;margin:0}
.quote small{display:block;margin-top:20px;color:#e5c98f;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px}
.resume{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px}
.resume h3{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:12px}
.timeline{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:20px;margin:20px 0}
.timeline b{color:var(--wine)}
.timeline p{font:13px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 18px}
.contact-card{background:var(--wine);color:white;padding:32px;border-radius:5px}
.contact-card h3{color:white}
.contact-card p{font:14px/1.8 Arial,sans-serif;color:#eadfe3}
.contact-card a{color:#f0cf8f}
footer{background:#2d1722;color:#e9dfe2;text-align:center;padding:28px 5%;font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px}
footer span{color:#d4ad6b}
@media(max-width:850px){.navwrap{align-items:flex-start}.menu{display:block}nav{display:none;position:absolute;top:62px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--cream);padding:15px 5%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);justify-content:flex-start}nav.open{display:flex}nav a{font-size:11px}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto}.hero-card{max-width:320px}.skills-grid,.project-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.wrap{padding:68px 6%}.about-grid,.contact-grid,.resume,.work-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.skills-grid,.project-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding-top:65px}.hero-card img{height:240px}.facts{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.quote{padding:30px}}

/* Added project artwork */
.project-art{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;padding:18px}
.project-art img{display:block;width:100%;height:360px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff8fb;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px}
.project-art.wide img{height:280px}
.project-art .art-caption{font:12px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0}
@media(max-width:600px){.project-art img{height:390px}.project-art.wide img{height:auto;max-height:300px}}

/* Refined portfolio presentation */
:root{
  --wine:#382044;--wine2:#65406f;--gold:#c49a55;--cream:#faf7fc;
  --ink:#30283a;--muted:#766d7d;--paper:#fff;--line:#e8ddec;
}
body{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fbf8fc 0%,#f5eff8 55%,#fcf8f1 100%);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
.topbar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-bottom:1px solid #e8ddec;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(56,32,68,.06)}
.navwrap{max-width:1240px;padding-top:13px;padding-bottom:13px}
.brand{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:2.5px}
.brand span{color:#a98245}
nav{gap:5px}
nav a{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.35px;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;color:#594c61}
nav a:hover,nav a.active{background:var(--wine);color:#fff;border-color:var(--wine);box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(56,32,68,.16)}
.menu{background:var(--wine);border-radius:9px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.wrap{max-width:1160px}
.hero{min-height:630px}
.hero:before{border-color:#e3d4e9}
.hero:after{background:#eee3f2}
.hero-card{border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #eadfee;box-shadow:0 25px 65px rgba(56,32,68,.13);transform:rotate(1deg)}
.hero-card img{border-radius:8px}
.btn{border-radius:9px;letter-spacing:1.1px}
.btn:hover{box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(56,32,68,.18)}
.panel,.skill,.item{border-radius:13px;border-color:#e8ddec;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(56,32,68,.055)}
.panel{padding:32px}
.skill,.item{transition:transform .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease}
.skill:hover,.item:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(56,32,68,.10)}
.fact{background:#f5eff8;border-left-color:var(--gold);border-radius:7px}
.tag{background:#f2eaf5}
.tinted{background:rgba(239,230,244,.58)}
.quote{border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#382044,#65406f);box-shadow:0 16px 35px rgba(56,32,68,.12)}
.contact-card{border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#382044,#65406f)}
footer{background:#281832}
.project-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:stretch}
.poem-page{
  position:relative;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff 0%,#fdf9ff 100%);
  border:1px solid #e6d9eb;border-radius:16px;padding:28px 30px 22px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(56,32,68,.075);overflow:hidden;
  min-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.poem-page:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;background:linear-gradient(#c49a55,#8c6599)}
.poem-page:after{content:"✦";position:absolute;right:22px;top:18px;color:#d8c29b;font-size:23px;opacity:.65}
.poem-topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-bottom:13px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee5f0;color:#a27b43;font:700 10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.6px}
.poem-page h3{font-size:25px;margin:20px 0 8px;color:#382044}
.poem-subtitle{font:12px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:#897d8d;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:90%}
.poem-body{font:15px/1.8 Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#514655;text-align:center;padding:20px 12px;background:#faf6fc;border:1px solid #f0e7f2;border-radius:10px;flex:1}
.poem-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:18px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #eee5f0;color:#a18b9f;font:9px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.poem-footer span{color:#c49a55;font-size:16px}
@media(max-width:850px){
 nav{gap:5px}
 nav a{padding:9px 10px}
 .project-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .poem-page{padding:25px 22px 20px}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .navwrap{align-items:center}
 nav{top:60px;gap:7px}
 nav a{padding:10px 12px}
 .project-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .poem-body{font-size:14px;padding:18px 8px}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar">
 <div class="navwrap">
  <a class="brand" href="#home">RMC <span>HUMSS PORTFOLIO</span></a>

<main>
<section id="home" class="wrap hero active">
 <div>
  <div class="name-line">A student • A storyteller • A dreamer</div>
  <h1>Rhyanna Mhae<br><em>Caliso</em></h1>
  <p class="lead">Welcome to my HUMSS student portfolio — a collection of my learning experiences, creative works, projects, and reflections. Every page represents a step toward becoming a more thoughtful, confident, and responsible individual.</p>
  <div class="actions"><a class="btn" href="#works">EXPLORE MY WORKS</a><a class="btn outline" href="#about">GET TO KNOW ME</a></div>
 </div>
 <div class="hero-card">
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Rhyanna Mhae Caliso">
  <div class="card-caption"><strong>Rhyanna Mhae Caliso</strong><small>HUMANITIES & SOCIAL SCIENCES</small></div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="about" class="wrap">
 <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">01 / Personal profile</div><h2>About Me</h2><p class="lead">A little introduction to the student behind this portfolio.</p></div>
 <div class="about-grid">
  <div class="panel"><h3>Hello, I'm Rhyanna!</h3><p>I am a student who believes that learning is more than memorizing facts. It is about understanding people, listening to different perspectives, expressing ideas, and discovering what I can contribute to the world.</p><p>Through the HUMSS strand, I continue to develop my communication, creativity, critical thinking, and appreciation of society and culture.</p></div>
  <div class="panel"><div class="profile-heading"><img class="profile-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Rhyanna Mhae Caliso"><div><h3>My Student Profile</h3><p class="profile-subtitle">A little more about me</p></div></div><div class="facts">
   <div class="fact"><b>Name</b><span>Rhyanna Mhae Caliso</span></div><div class="fact"><b>Strand</b><span>HUMSS</span></div>
   <div class="fact"><b>Grade & Section</b><span>To be completed</span></div><div class="fact"><b>School Year</b><span>2026–2027</span></div>
  </div></div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="skills" class="tinted">
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">02 / What I develop</div><h2>HUMSS Skills</h2><p class="lead">The abilities I practice as I explore people, communication, culture, and society.</p></div>
  <div class="skills-grid">
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">01</div><h3>Communication</h3><p>Sharing ideas clearly, listening actively, and expressing thoughts with respect.</p></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">02</div><h3>Critical Thinking</h3><p>Examining information, asking meaningful questions, and considering different viewpoints.</p></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">03</div><h3>Research</h3><p>Gathering information, checking sources, and organizing findings to understand an issue.</p></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">04</div><h3>Creativity</h3><p>Using imagination and original ideas in writing, presentations, and other outputs.</p></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">05</div><h3>Empathy</h3><p>Understanding the experiences of others and respecting differences in our community.</p></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="num">06</div><h3>Teamwork</h3><p>Working with classmates, sharing responsibilities, and contributing to group goals.</p></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="works" class="wrap">
 <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">03 / My collection</div><h2>My Works</h2><p class="lead">A space for written outputs and classroom activities that show my growth as a learner.</p></div>
 <div class="work-grid">
  <article class="item"><div class="type">Written output</div><h3>Creative Writing</h3><p>Poems, short compositions, and personal writing that allow me to communicate feelings, observations, and ideas through words.</p><span class="tag">Poetry</span><span class="tag">Self-expression</span></article>
  <article class="item"><div class="type">Academic output</div><h3>Essays & Analysis</h3><p>Written discussions that develop my ability to explain a topic, support a point of view, and organize information.</p><span class="tag">Writing</span><span class="tag">Analysis</span></article>
  <article class="item"><div class="type">Class activity</div><h3>Oral Presentations</h3><p>Activities that help me practice speaking with confidence, preparing ideas, and engaging with an audience.</p><span class="tag">Speaking</span><span class="tag">Confidence</span></article>
  <article class="item"><div class="type">Learning evidence</div><h3>Reflection & Worksheets</h3><p>Selected class tasks and reflections that record what I learned, what challenged me, and how I improved.</p><span class="tag">Learning</span><span class="tag">Progress</span></article>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="projects" class="tinted">
 <div class="wrap">
  <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">04 / Putting ideas into action</div><h2>Projects</h2><p class="lead">Projects connect classroom lessons with real-life situations and meaningful collaboration.</p></div>
  <div class="project-grid">
   <article class="item"><div class="type">Project idea 01</div><h3>Community Awareness</h3><p>A project concept focused on learning about a community concern, understanding its effects, and sharing useful information with others.</p></article>
   <article class="item"><div class="type">Project idea 02</div><h3>Culture & Identity</h3><p>An exploration of traditions, values, and experiences that shape the identity of individuals and communities.</p></article>
   <article class="item"><div class="type">Project idea 03</div><h3>Collaborative Presentation</h3><p>A group-based learning activity that combines research, planning, communication, and teamwork to present a topic.</p></article>

    <article class="poem-page">
      <div class="poem-topline"><span>POETRY PAGE 01</span><span>01 / 03</span></div>
      <h3>Within Your Own Light</h3>
      <p class="poem-subtitle">A poem about recognizing your strength and the light within you.</p>
      <div class="poem-body">
        You carry strength you often miss,<br>
        Through heavy days and quiet climbs,<br>
        Yet pause to honor how you’ve grown,<br>
        And how you stood through testing times.<br><br>
        No loud applause is needed here,<br>
        To prove the worth of every stride,<br>
        The courage just to try again,<br>
        Is spark enough to be your guide.<br><br>
        Speak gently to the tired heart,<br>
        That keeps on pushing toward the dawn,<br>
        Forgive the stumbles on the road,<br>
        And see how far you’ve carried on.<br><br>
        So lift your head and trust your pace,<br>
        You are enough just as you are,<br>
        The light you seek to lead you home,<br>
        Has been inside you from the start.
      </div>
      <div class="poem-footer">END OF PAGE 01 <span>✦</span></div>
    </article>

    <article class="poem-page">
      <div class="poem-topline"><span>POETRY PAGE 02</span><span>02 / 03</span></div>
      <h3>A Dream Worth Chasing</h3>
      <p class="poem-subtitle">A poem about holding on to dreams with faith, courage, and hard work.</p>
      <div class="poem-body">
        Far beyond the clouds,<br>
        A dream I hold so true,<br>
        A future bright, a life anew.<br><br>
        Though the path is rocky,<br>
        And the nights are cold,<br>
        I keep on going, brave and bold.<br><br>
        Because I know, deep in my heart,<br>
        That I can make it through,<br>
        With faith, hard work, and love,<br>
        I’ll reach what I’ve been looking for.<br><br>
        So let my dream be my guide,<br>
        My light in every fight,<br>
        And when I finally reach the stars,<br>
        I’ll know it was all worth the try.
      </div>
      <div class="poem-footer">END OF PAGE 02 <span>✦</span></div>
    </article>

    <article class="poem-page">
      <div class="poem-topline"><span>POETRY PAGE 03</span><span>03 / 03</span></div>
      <h3>Grateful Heart</h3>
      <p class="poem-subtitle">A poem about finding joy in blessings, love, and every new beginning.</p>
      <div class="poem-body">
        In every chapter of my life,<br>
        I find a reason to be thankful,<br>
        For the people who stay,<br>
        And the love that never ends.<br><br>
        Even in the darkest days,<br>
        I see a light so true,<br>
        A reminder that God is with me,<br>
        And He’s always pulling me through.<br><br>
        So I choose to be grateful,<br>
        For the lessons, the blessings,<br>
        And the chance to start again.<br><br>
        Because a grateful heart<br>
        Finds joy in every season,<br>
        And turns an ordinary life<br>
        Into something truly special.
      </div>
      <div class="poem-footer">END OF PAGE 03 <span>✦</span></div>
    </article>

  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="reflection" class="wrap">
 <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">05 / Looking back, moving forward</div><h2>Reflection</h2></div>
 <div class="quote"><p>“Every lesson gives me a chance to understand more, improve myself, and become more prepared for the future.”</p><small>MY PERSONAL LEARNING REFLECTION</small></div>
 <div class="panel" style="margin-top:22px"><p>My journey as a HUMSS student teaches me that learning also means being open-minded, responsible, and willing to grow. Some activities challenge me to speak up, work with others, or look at an issue from a different perspective. These experiences remind me that improvement takes patience and effort.</p><p>I am proud of the progress I make, even when it comes through small steps. Moving forward, I want to become more confident in expressing my ideas, more careful in understanding information, and more compassionate toward other people. I will use every challenge as an opportunity to learn.</p></div>
</section>

   <div><h3>Core Strengths</h3><div class="timeline"><b>Communication & Collaboration</b><p>Participating in discussions and contributing to group activities.</p><b>Writing & Creativity</b><p>Developing ideas through written and creative outputs.</p><b>Responsibility & Growth</b><p>Completing tasks, accepting feedback, and learning from experience.</p></div></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<section id="contact" class="wrap">
 <div class="section-head"><div class="eyebrow">07 / Say hello</div><h2>Contact</h2><p class="lead">Thank you for taking the time to explore my portfolio.</p></div>
 <div class="contact-grid">

<script>
const menuBtn=document.getElementById('menuBtn');
const nav=document.getElementById('nav');
const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav a')];
const sections=[...document.querySelectorAll('main section')];

function showSection(id){
  const target=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!target) return;
  sections.forEach(section=>section.classList.toggle('active',section.id===id));
  links.forEach(link=>link.classList.toggle('active',link.getAttribute('href')==='#'+id));
  nav.classList.remove('open');
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'auto'});
}
links.forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();
  showSection(link.getAttribute('href').slice(1));
}));
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link=>{
  if(link.closest('nav')) return;
  link.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    event.preventDefault();
    showSection(link.getAttribute('href').slice(1));
  });
});
menuBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>nav.classList.toggle('open'));
</script>
</body>
</html>
